name: Elune's Tear
label: Quest
description: Pelturas Whitemoon's young daughter Relara remains gripped by a foul and relentless malady, defying the herbal remedies brought from the northern ruins.…
intro: Pelturas Whitemoon's young daughter Relara remains gripped by a foul and relentless malady, defying the herbal remedies brought from the northern ruins. Desperate for a stronger cure, Pelturas sends an adventurer to Iris Lake to retrieve Elune's Tear, a sacred mineral revered by night elves for its power to wash away corruption.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child. We must find more powerful medicine! Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

Elune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... Please, friend, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, did you find Iris Lake? Do you have the Tear?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, you found it! I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.
